arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Directory whose application subdirectories hold the pre-validation JSON and SQLPlus deployment logs to check.

arguments.name: archive
arguments.description: Copy each application's pre-validation JSON and log into the workspace's post_validation_archive directory.

arguments.name: embed_log
arguments.description: Embed the deployment log in each application's HTML report.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when no application failed validation.

outputs.name: dashboard
outputs.description: Path to the HTML dashboard summarising all applications.

outputs.name: validated
outputs.description: Number of applications validated against a pre-validation JSON.

outputs.name: analyzed
outputs.description: Number of applications only analysed from their log (no pre-validation JSON).

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Number of applications whose status is fail.

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Per-application dashboard entries, including mode, status and report path.
